text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The stands are full of fans ready to
watch the
BNW showdown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see them! I've been a fan
since the
Japanese Derby!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
That was such a legendary race! I cry
every time I
watch the video.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
It's been a year and a half since then... I
wonder
how much they've improved!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Okay, you two—here we go! The ARIMA!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: KINEEEEEEEEEEN!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Huh? Come on, say it with me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Must we?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, to get ourselves all hyped! You
know,
huddle up and motivate each
other!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I'll pass.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Whaaaat? Today's the Arima Kinen, guys!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I don't intend to get you
any more
energetic than you already are.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Even small factors that could aid your
victory
must be avoided.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Exactly.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Aw, come oooon!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Fine! I get you're both serious! But I
don't wanna
lose either, you know?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'll just get pumped by myself! And I'll
win too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Haha... Yes, that's the spirit.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: We'll see who wins.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
YEAH! Now this is some real
competition!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I call out to the only person yelling in
their little
gang of three.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Come to see me off?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes wide open! Today I'm
gonna get
one heck of a victory!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Then you'll be inspired to dream big too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I can't help but smile at her brave
declaration.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It's time, Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The buzz of excitement outside for the
race is
tangible.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: (Go and show them a real BNW race!)

text_block_list.text: HERE WE GOOO!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: They dash away...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...and the audience welcomes BNW with
an
explosion of cheers!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
